fonts.display: 'Switzer', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Geist', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Parchment
palette.role: Page canvas and base background — the neutral ground everything sits on

palette.name: Warm Cream
palette.role: Section backgrounds, footer surface, and warm page rhythm — gives the system its apothecary warmth

palette.name: Paper White
palette.role: Text on dark imagery, elevated card surfaces, and bright contrast moments

palette.name: Mist Gray
palette.role: Subtle surface fills — nav background, button hover rests, and quiet UI layers

palette.name: Ink
palette.role: Primary body text and structural borders — softer than pure black, warmer against the cream

palette.name: Carbon
palette.role: Heading text, heavy borders, icon strokes — the highest-contrast neutral in the system

palette.name: Sky Blue
palette.role: Blue wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Pollen Yellow
palette.role: Highlight labels, breadcrumb tags, scroll-indicator text — rare warm punctuation against the cream
